outcomes.outcome: INPUT and FORWARD drop by default; the Hiera whitelist and the acl reach SSH unlimited
traffic to 127.0.0.0/8 arriving on another interface is rejected (rule 002)

uncovered.why: a packet to 127.0.0.0/8 that arrives on a non-loopback interface never reached INPUT on a lab node
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a node kind whose kernel passes a 127.0.0.0/8 destination from another interface to INPUT
uncovered.evidence: measured 2026-11-18 on the ubuntu node: 3 hand-built frames from the peer to 127.0.0.1 through the node's NIC were counted 0 by rule 002 with route_localnet 0 and again 0 with route_localnet 1 (escalations/firewall_secure_extra.behaviour.md)

outcomes.outcome: SSH from a host on no list is limited against brute force (overall 20 a minute with a burst of 5, 8 held per host, 15 new a minute per host)

invalid TCP packets (bogus flag combinations such as SYN+FIN, out-of-connection RSTs) and new TCP packets without SYN are dropped before routing (the rules set no protocol, so the type's tcp default applies)
TCP SYN packets with an MSS outside 536-65535 are dropped (rule 503), while a normal MSS connects
TCP fragments are dropped (rule 518; tcp by the type's default)

uncovered.why: TCP fragments never reached rule 518 on a lab node (connection tracking reassembles them before the filter)
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a node kind where fragments reach the filter table unreassembled (Phase 5 backlog #8)
uncovered.evidence: measured 2026-11-18 on the ubuntu node: 5 TCP-fragmented SYNs from the peer (hping3 -f) reached the node's NIC (tcpdump: 8-byte fragments) and were counted 0 by rule 518 and 0 by 501

outcomes.outcome: ICMP echo requests are limited to 2 per second
RST packets above 2 a second (burst 2) are dropped
only whitelisted sources reach the listed service, through the side chain
a whitelisted source holds at most ddos_limit connections to the service and opens new ones at the limited rate
a blacklisted source is dropped outright, every protocol (local change
rules Puppet does not manage are purged at the next agent run
the flush script the WARNING asks for clears every rule, and the next agent run rebuilds the class's firewall
sources from whitelisted countries reach the services (country_whitelist, src_cc)

uncovered.why: the geoip match (xt_geoip) needs xtables-addons and a GeoIP database, which no class installs
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: xt_geoip with a GeoIP database on a lab node
uncovered.evidence: Ubuntu 24.04's kernel and iptables carry no xt_geoip without xtables-addons; no class of the repository installs it; production's country_whitelist is not set in node files (diagnosis/fleet_variant_usage.md)

outcomes.outcome: unlisted sources on the service port are forwarded to an internal landing server (internal_forward)

uncovered.why: forwarding to an internal landing server needs an internal network behind the node with a server on it
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: an internal network behind a lab node (the lab's nodes share one host-only link)
uncovered.evidence: nodes.yml (2026-11-23): every node kind has NIC1 NAT and NIC2 on vboxnet0 only; no internal network exists

outcomes.outcome: with anti_ddos but without ip_filter, every source is held to the per-source connection and rate limits on the listed services in INPUT
without anti_ddos the listed service ports are simply opened, and strict mode admits only listed SSH sources
